name: DETETIVE ESTÁGIARIO
source:
In the city of Beskeville, a crime has taken place surrounded by mysteries and you will have to investigate them, find clues and interrogate the suspects, will you be able to find the imposter?

[Translated from [url=https://starnathy-arts.itch.io/detetive-estgiario]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
贝斯克维尔市发生了一起谜团重重的犯罪事件，你必须调查案件，寻找线索，审问嫌疑人，你能找到冒名顶替者吗？

[译自[url=https://starnathy-arts.itch.io/detetive-estgiario]Itch.io[/url]]
